The bond gets more intense, but not more honest.","development":"Venus last moved through Scorpio from {{previousResidencyEntryDate}} to {{previousResidencyExitDate}}, and similar questions of attachment can surface now in different forms. We collect more clues, but become less able to receive what is offered without wondering what it hides.","close":"Before {{exitDate}}, repeated tests can leave a bond full of doubt and short on the trust they were meant to prove.","try_this":["We can ask one direct question about a current bond instead of checking for clues.","We can accept one offered kindness, such as a meal or a ride, without treating it as a debt or a test."]}
